about_the_game:
You know what’s missing in this world? A regular pilsner.

In a world overrun by craft beer enthusiasts and their endless creative brews, one grumpy guy is on a quest to find one thing: the basic pilsner.

An evil Master Brewer has banned pilsner and is hunting down all who dare to drink it. But our mustachioed hero has a plan: enter a brewing contest to bring it back. Along the way, he’ll need to gather brewing ingredients, find right equipment, and even team up with the rebels in “The Pilsner Front.”

Can you defeat the IPA regime and bring pilsner to the world once again?

Hey beer lovers! Ready for the ultimate night out? Grab your favorite brew and dive into this cozy adventure through Oslo's best bars! With its sweet ‘90s vibe, classic point-and-click navigation, and gorgeous comic book style, you’ll explore 30 unique locations. Your trusty Beer-o-meter tracks your tipsy choices, leading to unexpected consequences along the way.

It’s just like a legendary night out with friends, full of unforgettable stories, minus the hangover! 

The demo:

Check out our demo featuring the first 5 locations from the full game. Solve puzzles that change based on your Beer-o-meter level: your decisions and solutions might be completely different depending on your level of drunkness. Get introduced to the story and uncover the first hints of the Master Brewer's sinister plan, all wrapped in our unique comic book style.

Sequel to Dude, Where Is My Beer? (2020):  After their award-winning debut with the original title, this developer duo returns with a brand-new craft beer adventure!

Wishlist Dude, Where Is My Beer? A New Hop today and get a free beer*

*beer not included
